title: Photronics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Photronics, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.

## Photronics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


August 20, 2026 at 4:00 PM EDT


[PDF Version](https://photronicsinc.gcs-web.com/node/19671/pdf)


BROOKFIELD, Conn., Aug. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Photronics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=09pC-7Ua--5ZW0ZPLXsAoV255cDn6wjNvVWu4CNpJHNnDV7KEQaerQTO9GBUUIjy-7mXzlDrKobL2O13vSiJoz1oSP27IMZkXqXjexWzye0dxRiwi-zw86hXHh4xqqkc) (Nasdaq:PLAB), a worldwide leader in photomask technologies and solutions, today announced it will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


**Three Part Advisors Midwest IDEAS Conference**
Date: August 27, 2026
Location: Chicago


**Lake Street Capital BIG10 Conference**
Date: September 10, 2026
Location: New York City


**About Photronics**


[Photronics](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=09pC-7Ua--5ZW0ZPLXsAoa1W2JaR0l8a3ieODyl1ZR4xO4ghr2RqO265pPyyeJCmrciAR48_TBUn5jrKqWPsZUmbbnhNKRv-7prhnZZun-c=) is a leading worldwide manufacturer of integrated circuit (IC) and flat panel display (FPD)[photomasks.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=uCABnpjPD2daOe0F_GiHjOEdkOgsx6bEWl5zi517SPcu_Rr-GtqDzh5CTFKfdK3e6-q54PSBg-iQ5LNjlhnWP4wRCxpQasCgeZvA-XS9IQDO2Uzd_7fi7sxh9ZdSKCOrCJqbHyH5dB50EFilsiJy1FzlVz2OhMJbsKqST5mr9Io=) High precision quartz plates that contain microscopic images of electronic circuits, photomasks are a key element in the IC and FPD manufacturing process. Founded in 1969, Photronics has been a trusted photomask supplier for over 56 years. The company operates 11 strategically located[manufacturing facilities](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dO9C9GfFM3-dp9_gIasbWcvAXRzod0AFXEjjWDb4Z4iEqZDNcDRoM2mcZNzsKh0-zNu4bwp7IOxKDoCV3v_pEnbKcZtP0z2Ik2IB607orplP17pKkekdq9A2ElRd1u3hsGwIX-cVTSfCgpHEVlQqLg==) in Asia, Europe, and North America. Additional information on the company can be accessed at[www.photronics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8j7S_2aqn14CgRODUVLttjETuvow5jxdniI9fgLUZh8dx-u2DaixK0SrtHDUQTpUh01_kArwljnonFAGSLAYcG02K0nT0vlMXF00u86sGgQ=) .
